mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO agent_step (run_id, sequence, step_type, action, input_summary, output_summary, sources, duration_ms, error_code, created_at) VALUES
(#{step.runId}, #{step.sequence}, #{step.stepType}, #{step.action}, #{step.inputSummary}, #{step.outputSummary}, #{step.sources, typeHandler=com.hfusionhub.handler.JsonTypeHandler}, #{step.durationMs}, #{step.errorCode}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS id, s.action AS tool_name, s.duration_ms AS duration_ms, s.error_code AS error_code, s.output_summary AS error_summary, s.created_at AS created_at, t.id AS task_id, t.query AS task_query, t.status AS task_status FROM agent_step s JOIN agent_run r ON s.run_id = r.id JOIN agent_task t ON r.task_id = t.id WHERE s.step_type = 'tool_call' AND t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_step s JOIN agent_run r ON s.run_id = r.id JOIN agent_task t ON r.task_id = t.id WHERE s.step_type = 'tool_call' AND t.user_id = #{userId}
